pattern_architecture.name: Dress the architecture
pattern_architecture.description: Batched skins on actual floor and exposed wall cells of the containing SimGrid. Explicitly selects loom, kaleidoscope, press or mill live output, target, hold, repeat size and tint. Collision and source machines remain independent.
pattern_architecture.qfep_connection: A repeated rule makes an address, a field or an environment; the receiver and body determine what can be encountered.
